modelingNotes: Camp North End: The General's Office — procedural, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-cne-generals-office.ts

A small one-storey office of the Army depot, 300 Camp Road, standing against the east end of `clt-cne-330-camp-road`, named The General's Office by Camp North End (the origin of the name is not published). A flat-roofed brick box 14 × 12 m with a small raised block on its roof.

Evidence: - OSM: way/672998898 ("The General's Office", height 5.5, addr 300 Camp Road), its part way/835851711 (height 5.5) and the multipolygon part relation/18229983 (height 4.5) that covers the rest. - Lidar, USGS 3DEP NC Phase 4 Mecklenburg 2016, 1 m (measured, NAVD88): roof 231.6–231.7; the raised block 232.7; ground 227.1 on the north, 228.3 on the south (y = 0 is 227.1: the roof is 4.6 m above it, the block 5.6 m). - Camp North End leasing brochure (2021, camp.nc): "300 Camp Road", 2,000 sq ft. Mecklenburg County tax parcel 07903102 (CAMP LANDOWNER LP), 1943–55.

No licensed photo was found. The brick, the windows and the door are estimated; the raised block's purpose (a skylight or plant) is unknown. Under the 300 m² floor for small buildings, built because it is named and historic.
Frame: the Ford plant's grid, placement bearing 6.3; origin at the outline's centroid, lng −80.8334231, lat 35.2464367. Kit: `clt-cne-301-camp-road.ts`.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-cne-generals-office", model "clt-cne-generals-office"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-cne-generals-office.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
